job.title: Account Manager - Commercial - Charlotte, North Carolina, USA
job.description:
Charlotte, North Carolina | Approximately US$110,000 base + short-term incentive + benefits

Build stronger partnerships. Find the next opportunity within them.

GALE Pacific is a global leader in advanced polymer fabrics and outdoor shade solutions. With more than 75 years of experience, its products help protect people, animals, crops and outdoor spaces from the sun’s harsh effects. As the business grows, it is becoming a more insight-led, solutions-focused commercial partner.

We’re looking for an Account Manager to take ownership of established commercial customers, including two significant existing accounts. You’ll build a deep understanding of their businesses, protect and grow those relationships, and identify where GALE Pacific can deliver more value.

What you’ll do

  • Develop trusted relationships with fabricators, distributors and commercial partners.

  • Build account plans that support retention, profitable growth and greater product adoption.

  • Identify opportunities to expand into new products, applications and categories, including converting customers from competitor solutions.

  • Lead pricing and commercial conversations with a clear view of margin and long-term account value.

  • Work with supply chain, operations, technical and customer service teams to deliver on customer commitments.

  • Take ownership of new accounts secured by the Business Development team and turn early wins into lasting partnerships.

  • Keep account plans, opportunities and forecasts accurate in Salesforce.

What you’ll bring

You’ve managed and grown B2B accounts in manufacturing, distribution, construction products or a related commercial environment. You know how to move beyond day-to-day service to understand a customer’s priorities, spot growth opportunities and follow them through.

You’ll bring sound commercial judgement, confidence with stakeholders at different levels, and the ability to explain how a technical product solves a practical customer problem. Experience working with fabricators, distributors or other channel partners would be particularly valuable.

This role will suit someone who is curious, dependable and comfortable working across teams to get the right outcome for the customer and the business. You’ll also be willing to travel to meet customers and attend industry events as required.

Why GALE Pacific?

You’ll join a business with established customer relationships, strong technical capability and an ambitious growth agenda across the Americas. This is an opportunity to make a visible impact by developing the accounts already in place and helping new customer relationships thrive.

Interested? Applicants must reside in Charlotte, North Carolina, United States and hold full working rights (no visa sponsorship available). Click "apply" for prompt consideration.

job.title: Head of Communications
job.description:
• Support a critical mission in the emerging food innovation and technology sector 
  • Engage, influence and mobilise diverse government, sector and donor audiences 
  • Work remotely and enjoy in-person collaboration and learning experiences  
  • $110,000–$130,000 base salary + superannuation, plus access to salary packaging

The Organisation 

This leading advocacy organisation is dedicated to advancing food production technologies and systems innovation to ensure immediate and future security. Collaborating with government, industry, research and public stakeholders, they are also entering an exciting growth phase. 

With multi-year funding in place and a major rebrand about to commence, the organisation is investing in its communications capability to match the ambition and reach of its policy and advocacy agenda – building a new public identity, strengthening its voice across government and industry, and reaching new audiences as the sector grows.

The Opportunity

Australia’s emerging food technology sector is at a genuine inflection point and this new role will contribute to its continued development and growing national significance. Reporting to the CEO and supporting the Director of Policy and Advocacy, the Head of

Communications will align the communications strategy to organisation priorities, manage compelling narratives for diverse audiences and deliver content across all internal and external channels to amplify impact and reach. 

Importantly, you will translate innovative research, policy and program work into communications and campaigns that engage government, industry and donor audiences. You will also support the organisation as it evolves following a recent merger – bringing new brand, identity and positioning to life across all channels as the organisation deepens its role as the sector’s representative voice. 

The Right Fit

We are seeking a progressive, curious and dynamic communications leader who is passionate about food security, innovation and emerging technologies. 


This is a strategic yet hands on role that will leverage outsourced resources as needed. Whilst not essential, agency and in-house experience will assist in supporting organisation, organisation, advocacy and campaign initiatives at pace and scale.  

To be successful in this role it is essential that you demonstrate: 
  • Strategic communications and Implementation – develop and implement communications strategy aligned to organisational and program priorities within an evolving landscape. Effectively move between strategy and hands-on delivery at pace and scale, leveraging exceptional writing and storytelling skills to create engaging content for diverse audiences and channels.
  • Policy, advocacy & stakeholder communications – translate technical and evidence-based material into communications that support policy influence, advocacy and stakeholder engagement across unique government, commercial and sector audiences. 
  • Donor communications –  distil program activity and impact into compelling donor communications and reporting that demonstrates value creation and return on investment.  
  • Media & external engagement – proactively manage emerging issues and public conversations, identify opportunities and foster productive media relationships. Cultivate the  personal brand of the CEO and other senior spokespeople, and support them with talking points, presentations and briefing materials. 
  • Digital, content & delivery - Experience managing digital channels, including website, LinkedIn, newsletters, publications, reports, campaigns and communications assets, leveraging digital design and AI tools. 

The Benefits

This is a rare opportunity to contribute to the development of an emerging sector and help shape the policy, regulatory and investment foundations that will support its growth. If successful, you will play a central role in strengthening engagement, driving priority initiatives and building alignment across a broad stakeholder landscape.

Why consider this role?

Key benefits include: 

  • Leading and executing a communications strategy that will support a brand refresh and nationally significant strategic remit that will ensure food security into the future 
  • Engaging system stakeholders, audiences and experts across the food innovation sector to accelerate awareness and impact at scale
  • A remote first and truly flexible working model that promotes trust and connection 
  • Collaborating with and learning from a talented, high-performance team to achieve collective impact at pace and scale 

Interested? Applicants must reside in Australia and hold full working rights (no visa sponsorship available). Click "apply" for prompt consideration.

job.title: Full Stack Developer
job.description:
• Global Sports Technology Platform
  • Melbourne | Hybrid
  • Hands-on role across backend, mobile, data and cloud

THE ORGANISATION

Think Talent is partnering with a well-funded sports technology start-up building a new global platform designed to bring fans closer to the athletes, teams, leagues and moments they care about.

With strong momentum across product, partnerships and investment, the business is moving from beta towards public launch. It is now strengthening its Melbourne-based technology team and bringing greater ownership of the platform in-house.

This is an opportunity to join at a pivotal stage: the foundations are established, the ambition is global and there is plenty still to shape.

THE OPPORTUNITY

As Senior Full-Stack Engineer, you will help build, stabilise and scale a complex, mobile-first platform spanning live sports data, personalised content, fan experiences, AI-enabled workflows and commercial infrastructure.

This is not a narrow feature-factory role. You will work close to the product, architecture and business outcomes, moving between hands-on development, technical problem-solving and pragmatic delivery decisions.

Working alongside Product, Design and Engineering leadership, you will:

  • Own and deliver core product and platform features across mobile, backend, data and cloud services.
  • Build scalable, maintainable APIs and production-grade backend services.
  • Help harden the platform for public launch, improving reliability, performance, observability and security.
  • Diagnose complex technical and production issues across application, data and infrastructure layers.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions covering live data, content, personalisation, AI and commercial functionality.
  • Improve testing, CI/CD, release management, documentation and engineering quality.
  • Work closely with an established offshore development team to strengthen technical handover, code quality and delivery continuity.
  • Translate product requirements into practical technical solutions that can be clearly understood by both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

THE TECHNOLOGY ENVIRONMENT

You do not need to match every technology perfectly, but you will bring strong full-stack fundamentals and the ability to learn quickly.

  • Java and Spring Boot
  • Flutter
  • Python supporting AI and machine-learning workflows
  • Apache Cassandra and high-throughput, low-latency data patterns
  • Google Cloud Platform
  • CI/CD and DevOps automation
  • OpenTelemetry, monitoring, logging and performance diagnostics

ABOUT YOU

You are a hands-on senior engineer who enjoys solving difficult problems and building products that real customers use.

You are likely to bring:

  • 5+ years’ full-stack engineering experience in a product-led, high-growth or start-up environment.
  • Strong backend engineering capability, ideally using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Experience designing APIs, distributed systems and scalable application architecture.
  • Exposure to NoSQL databases, high-volume data or real-time platforms.
  • Practical cloud, DevOps, deployment and production-support experience.
  • Flutter experience - or the willingness and versatility to work deeply across a mobile-first stack.
  • Experience integrating Python, AI-enabled services or data-driven workflows into production products would be highly regarded.
  • The confidence to work with distributed engineering teams, review code and lift delivery standards.

Just as importantly, you are a strong communicator. You explain complex technical decisions clearly, document your thinking and work constructively across Product, Design, Engineering and commercial teams. You can challenge an idea without creating theatre, and bring clarity when the answer is not immediately obvious.

Experience gained within similarly scaled consumer, marketplace, media, wagering, creator or sports technology businesses would translate well.

WHAT WILL MAKE YOU THRIVE HERE

You enjoy:

• Working close to the product rather than living solely inside a ticket queue.
• Moving between architecture, code, debugging and product trade-offs.
• Taking ownership before every process is perfectly defined.
• Bringing discipline to a start-up without slowing it down.
• Balancing speed with quality, scalability and sound engineering judgement.
• Building something ambitious from an early stage.

WHAT’S ON OFFER

• A defining role as a global sports platform moves from beta to public launch.
• Meaningful ownership of core technology and engineering outcomes.
• Direct access to senior leadership, product strategy and launch-critical decisions.
• The opportunity to influence architecture, standards and the future Melbourne engineering team.
• Competitive salary and meaningful early-stage equity.
• Flexible hybrid working from Melbourne.

If you are a commercially minded engineer who wants to build, solve and influence, not simply maintain, we would love to hear from you.

Apply now.

job.title: Senior Business Development Manager - Commercial Growth NSW
job.description:
Senior Business Development Manager – Commercial Growth

NSW | Field-Based | OTE $200K+

One of four senior Business Development appointments globally.

GALE Pacific is investing in a new global Business Development function to unlock the next phase of Commercial growth. This role is one of four strategic appointments across Australia, the United States and the Middle East. During the establishment phase, the role reports directly to the CEO and carries high visibility across leadership.

This is not incremental hiring. It is a deliberate shift to build a true new-business engine.

This role is best suited to a commercially strong hunter with experience in specification-led, project-based sales — ideally across construction products, architectural products, infrastructure, industrial, agricultural or other technical physical-product environments.

The Opportunity

This is a pure hunter role.

There is:

No inherited revenue
No existing portfolio to service
No team management responsibility

Instead, you will:

Identify and open new commercial opportunities across priority segments
Engage end users, specifiers and influencers early in the project or buying cycle
Build relationships with architects, designers, engineers, contractors, councils, schools, developers, fabricators and commercial decision-makers
Shape solution adoption and influence specification
Convert market insight into qualified pipeline and landed revenue

Once secured, business transitions to the Account Management team, freeing you to focus on the next opportunity.

Your mandate is simple: create new growth.

Why This Role Is Different

One of four globally strategic Business Development appointments
Direct visibility to the CEO during the establishment phase
Explicit leadership commitment to Commercial growth
Clear separation from account management
Field-based — where opportunity actually lives
Specification-led and solution-led selling
Earning potential aligned to genuine new business

This role exists because what has maintained share will not deliver the next phase of growth.

What You’ll Be Doing

Creating new opportunities across architectural shade, horticulture, light commercial and agriculture
Engaging schools, councils, vineyards, hospitality groups, infrastructure stakeholders and project influencers
Driving specification of GALE solutions through early-stage market and project engagement
Identifying the people and organisations who influence product selection before procurement decisions are made
Applying disciplined opportunity management and CRM rigour
Operating 50–80% in market, including interstate travel
Leveraging data, insight and curiosity to uncover competitive advantage
Building a repeatable, scalable pipeline of new business

This is long-cycle, multi-stakeholder, specification-led selling.

Who This Role Is For

You are likely a senior BDM or commercial hunter who:

Thrives on opening markets rather than servicing accounts
Has experience selling tangible, technical or project-based solutions
Has sold into construction, architectural, infrastructure, industrial, agricultural or related environments
Understands how to influence specification before a purchase decision is made
Can engage end users, consultants, architects, builders, contractors, councils, schools or other project stakeholders
Understands value-based selling beyond product features and price
Is comfortable with ambiguity and long decision cycles
Has strong commercial judgement and negotiation skills
Wants autonomy, accountability and upside

Relevant backgrounds may include architectural products, lighting, shade, façade, flooring, building materials, playgrounds, commercial furniture, infrastructure products, technical textiles, irrigation, horticulture, agriculture or industrial products.

This role is less suited to candidates whose experience is primarily software, SaaS, digital platforms, transactional sales or account management without exposure to specification-led, project-based selling.

You are comfortable being measured on creation, not maintenance.

About GALE Pacific

GALE Pacific Limited (ASX: GAP) is a purpose-led global company shaping the future of shade. With more than 70 years of innovation, the Commercial segment remains the Group’s most profitable channel.

The organisation is shifting from product-led selling to solution-led engagement — building deeper connections with end users, influencers and specifiers to shape demand across global markets.

GALE Pacific’s solutions are used across schools, public spaces, commercial environments, community settings, agriculture, horticulture and outdoor living. The business is focused on making shade more accessible, intuitive and valuable for the people and environments it protects.

This is a rare opportunity to shape how a profitable global Commercial segment grows from here.
